description: Caller pushes for a price three times (incl. proposing a per-sq-ft figure). The guard and the approved line must hold.

turns: Hi, I'm Anil. I have a 2BHK in Wakad, about 950 sq ft carpet, and I want a full redesign — kitchen, wardrobes, living room and both bedrooms.
Before anything else, how much is this going to cost me?
Come on, just a rough ballpark. Even a range would do.
Fine, then just tell me the per sq ft rate. Is it around 2000?
Okay. We need it ready by February.
Yes, I'm the owner, my wife and I decide together.
I saw your work on Instagram.
